switch: THIRD_PARTY_LOGOS in scripts/shared/logos.mjs turns every logo in this file off

logos.name: Premier League logo
logos.owner: The Football Association Premier League Limited
logos.download: PL_Digital_Positive.zip, downloaded by the founder on 2026-11-21
logos.variant: purple (positive), for light backgrounds; the site is light only
logos.termsAccepted: 2026-11-21, by the founder ("downloaded, we are ok to use them")
rules: Purple version on light backgrounds, white version on dark backgrounds.
Resize only. Never recolour, redraw, crop, distort, animate or add effects.
Shown small (24px high) beside the words "Premier League" where a page already names the competition.
Never on posters, storefront tiles or feeds, og or share cards, navigation, mastheads, section identity, the Wire or the app feeds.
logos.requiredNotice: © Copyright The Football Association Premier League Limited, 2016.
logos.noticeWhere: LEGAL_LINE in scripts/shared/page-shell.mjs (every static footer) and the hand copy in index.html
logos.removalDuty: Remove from the site within 12 hours of a request from the Premier League: set THIRD_PARTY_LOGOS to false, rebuild and deploy.
